description: This PHP class defines an EmployeeModel used within the OrangeHRM system's API module. It models employee data including identifiers and personal details, and is used for serialization and normalization within the API framework.

classes.name: EmployeeModel
classes.description: Represents an employee data model for API serialization, based on an Employee entity, providing filters and attribute mappings for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeModel with an Employee entity, setting up filters and attribute mappings for API serialization.
